description: This file defines an interface ShoppingCartFacade, which provides an abstraction layer for shopping cart operations between the core module and the web controller. It includes method signatures for adding, removing, updating, and retrieving shopping cart data, as well as creating and deleting shopping carts.

classes.name: ShoppingCartFacade
classes.description: Interface providing shopping cart related operations to be implemented by service classes.

methods.name: addItemsToShoppingCart
methods.description: Adds an item to the shopping cart for a specific customer and merchant store.

methods.name: createCartModel
methods.description: Creates a new shopping cart model based on a shopping cart code, merchant store, and customer.

methods.name: getShoppingCartData
methods.description: Retrieves shopping cart data based on customer, store, and cart ID, or directly from a ShoppingCart object or code.

methods.name: removeCartItem
methods.description: Removes an item from the shopping cart based on item ID.

methods.name: updateCartItem
methods.description: Updates the quantity of an item in the shopping cart.

methods.name: deleteShoppingCart
methods.description: Deletes a shopping cart by ID or code.

methods.name: updateCartItems
methods.description: Updates multiple shopping cart items at once.

methods.name: getShoppingCartModel
methods.description: Retrieves the shopping cart model based on code or customer.

calls: ShoppingCartData addItemsToShoppingCart(ShoppingCartData, ShoppingCartItem, MerchantStore, Language, Customer)
ShoppingCartData updateCartItem(Long, String, long, MerchantStore, Language)
